notes: v1.1: claims C6 and C7 added after both pilot runs independently found these discrepancies; paper status changed to computational issues with no alternative (R7). C4 is close, with match accepted. The earlier hypothetical 'discrepant P3' was not adopted. Reconciled with the second labeller (see reconciliation.md). The final judgement is the structured label; notes_blind_original keeps the pre-reconciliation blind notes, which are historical and superseded wherever they conflict with the final label.
notes_blind_original: The report states results as 'percent' (31.9, 19.8, 18.2 percent); I read these as the coefficients 0.319, 0.198, 0.182 on the outcome scale, since the report compares them directly with the printed coefficients. C4: 'discrepant' with severity P3 is defensible (0.198 does not round to 0.19), but the report counts it as replicated, so 'close'. Report found one non-fatal code error in the shipped Figure 2 code (BPV_museums_maintext.R line 224, 'for (i in 22:34){results.df.tj$Variable[i] <- "pardoned"}' -> 'replacement has 25 rows, data has 24'); the figure was still produced and 'There were no differences between the replicated graphs and the graphs shown in the original article' (P3, no numeric consequence). Paper text checked in the accepted manuscript only. Robustness sections (gender, indices, mediation) ignored.
